# StaticNorth.Valiant

> StaticNorth.Valiant is a family of source-generated .NET libraries for validation, endpoint-per-class Minimal APIs, object mapping, and strongly typed settings.

Use the current documentation for the `StaticNorth.Valiant.*` package and C# namespace family. Generated code is designed for explicit startup registration, trimming, and Native AOT rather than runtime assembly scanning.

## Documentation

- [Documentation home](https://valiant.staticnorth.dev/): Current Valiant documentation.
- [Validation](https://valiant.staticnorth.dev/validation/): Validator authoring, rules, ASP.NET Core, OpenAPI, and mediator integrations.
- [Endpoints](https://valiant.staticnorth.dev/endpoints/): Endpoint-per-class Minimal APIs, groups, registration, and query binding.
- [Mapping](https://valiant.staticnorth.dev/mapping/): Compile-time object mapping, explicit rules, composition, and dependency injection.
- [Settings](https://valiant.staticnorth.dev/settings/): Generated schemas, Options binding, validation, and the ASP.NET Core settings explorer.

## Packages and source

- [NuGet package family](https://www.nuget.org/packages/StaticNorth.Valiant.Validation/): Start with the core package and select the required `StaticNorth.Valiant.*` integration packages.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/static-north-dev/valiant): Source, samples, issues, and release history.

## Optional

- [Full current documentation](https://valiant.staticnorth.dev/llms-full.txt): Complete current documentation in one generated Markdown context; excludes historical version snapshots.

## Agent access

- [Agent documentation](https://valiant.staticnorth.dev/agents): Markdown access, version selection, skills, MCP, WebMCP, and HTTP documentation tools.
- [Versioned document index](https://valiant.staticnorth.dev/agents/documents.json): Available documentation versions, exact page paths, Markdown URLs, and source revision. Select the installed package major before using examples.
- [Authoring skills](https://valiant.staticnorth.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Validation, Endpoints, Mapping, and Settings guidance with SHA-256 digests.
- [Documentation API](https://valiant.staticnorth.dev/openapi.json): Public read-only list, search, and read operations. No authentication is required.
- [MCP server card](https://valiant.staticnorth.dev/mcp/server-card): Connect to the real documentation MCP endpoint using Streamable HTTP.
